outcome: Adverse obstetric outcomes (gestational diabetes, hypertensive disorders, delivery complications)
cohort: Female patients aged 18-52 undergoing bariatric surgery
finding: Giving birth was common in the first 2 years after bariatric surgery and was not associated with an increased risk of reinterventions.
mod_finding: This study found that 48.5% of births after bariatric surgery were first-time cesarean deliveries.
